declarations.name: AuiSidebar

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the <nav> (aria-label) and the drawer title, e.g. "Main". Must not be empty.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Navigation tree (at least one item; groups need at least one child). Ids are unique across the whole tree; labels are non-empty. Links without href render as buttons.

inputs.name: collapsible
inputs.description: Render the collapse (rail) toggle in the footer.

inputs.name: breakpoint
inputs.description: Integer 0..4096: viewport width in CSS px below which the sidebar becomes a modal drawer. 0 never switches.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: 'rtl' sets dir="rtl" on the <nav> and footer; tooltips and the drawer also follow an inherited rtl direction.

models.name: value
models.description: Active (current page) item id; must be a non-group item. Default: no active item.

models.name: collapsed
models.description: Icon rail: labels are visually hidden and shown as tooltips. Inline mode only; forced to false when collapsible is false.

models.name: expanded
models.description: Expanded group ids. Every id must be a group id.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: The user activated an enabled item (unmodified primary click, Enter, or Space on a button). preventDefault stops link navigation, the active change, and the drawer close.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The active item changed after an uncanceled aui-navigate. Not emitted when the active item is activated again.

outputs.name: groupToggled
outputs.description: The user toggled a group. value lists all expanded group ids in tree order.

outputs.name: modeChange
outputs.description: The viewport crossed the breakpoint after creation. The initial mode is not reported.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the drawer is open (always false inline).

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the drawer; focus moves into it. No-op in inline mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the drawer; focus returns to the element focused before open(). No-op when closed or inline.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Mark a non-group item active and expand its groups. No events; does not close the drawer. Throws SIDEBAR_OPTIONS for an unknown or group id.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Disclosure Navigation: a navigation landmark with lists of links, groups as disclosure buttons (aria-expanded + aria-controls), and aria-current="page" on the active item. Drawer mode uses the Drawer (modal <dialog>) pattern; the rail uses Tooltip as the accessible name.

limitations: No arrow-key navigation between items; every enabled item and group button is a separate Tab stop.
The drawer breakpoint follows the viewport width, not the width of the sidebar's container.
The application must render its own menu button to open the drawer; the sidebar's collapse toggle is hidden in drawer mode.
The collapsed (rail) state applies inline only; it is ignored in drawer mode and forced to false when collapsible is false.
Disabled items get no rail tooltip, so in the icon rail they show only their icon or initial.
select() does not close the drawer; call close() after it.
Nothing is persisted; collapsed and expanded state reset when the sidebar is recreated unless the application passes them back.
